segments.he: חֶצְיָיהּ לַבַּיִת הַמְנוּגָּע, וַחֲצִי חֶצְיָיהּ לִפְסוֹל אֶת הַגְּוִיָּיה.
segments.en: We learned in the mishna that the time it takes to eat «half» the loaf is the time it takes «for» the clothes of one who entered «a leprous house» to become ritually impure, and «half of its half,» of the loaf, is the amount of ritually impure food that «disqualifies the body» from eating teruma.

moves.about: lemma: half the loaf for a leprous house, a quarter to disqualify the body
